If your situation is severe or involves anything that frightens you, get professional help rather than advice from strangers. That's not weakness, it's proportion.

column2: ATSA Public Engagement (channel)
column5: Public engagement from a research body is genuinely useful, because most of this subject reaches people through influencers instead. Porn discourse online is dominated by people selling something. Research-based sources are more cautious and less satisfying, which is precisely why they're more reliable. Add one boring credible source to your feed. The dull version will steer you better than the exciting one.

column2: Ruth Institute (channel)
column5: Advocacy work has a place, though it's worth reading it as advocacy rather than as neutral science. Porn's industry harms are documented and real, and that case doesn't need embellishment. The GirlsDoPorn trafficking convictions and Pornhub's 2020 removal of millions of unverified videos are matters of record. Refuse it on the documented grounds. Those are stronger than anything you'd need to exaggerate.

column2: Culture Reframed (channel)
column5: Culture Reframed focuses on prevention rather than shame, which is the more useful end of the problem. Porn now reaches children years before anyone gives them a framework for it. Most people report first exposure between eleven and thirteen, usually accidentally and unsupervised. Prevention is enormously cheaper than repair. If you've got kids, this is the work worth doing now rather than later.

column2: What You Need to Know About Kids and Porn - Culture Reframed
column5: Parent-directed and practical, which is what most people searching this actually need. Porn found your children through an environment adults built, not through any failure of theirs. Calm, early, factual conversation is associated with better outcomes than either silence or panic. Start before you think it's necessary. Every parent who waited for the right moment reports the moment arrived years too late.

column2: CULTURE REFRAMED and Dr. Bethany Mohr
column5: Bringing clinical expertise into the prevention conversation strengthens it considerably. Porn exposure in childhood is now common enough to be a public health question rather than a private one. Clinicians who see the downstream effects tend to be more measured and more credible than campaigners. Listen to the measured version. It's less alarming and much harder to dismiss.

column2: Dr. Gail Dines explains how the porn industry shapes sexual templates
column5: The sexual templates point is one of the more useful ideas in this entire area. Porn teaches a script before most people have any experience to compare it against. Repeated exposure shapes expectations of real partners in ways people rarely notice until a relationship strains against them. Examine the script you were handed. You never agreed to it and you can hand it back.

column2: Introducing Culture Reframed's Porn-Critical Sex Education
column5: Porn-critical sex education is a sensible middle path between abstinence messaging and pretending it's harmless. Porn is now the default sex educator for a generation, which nobody chose. Comprehensive, factual sex education is associated with better outcomes than either silence or fear-based approaches. Give young people something accurate to compare against. Accuracy competes with porn far better than prohibition does.

column2: Defend Dignity - Porn as a Public Health Crisis
column5: The public health framing shifts this out of the moral category, which mostly helps. Porn is discussed as a private failing when the drivers are structural: access, design and profit. Medical and public health framing increases help-seeking and reduces the shame that suppresses it. Whether or not "crisis" is the right word, treating it as a systemic issue gets more people help than blaming individuals.

column2: Ep. 37 Porn Culture - Gail Dines Founder of Culture Reframed & Robert Rabbin
column5: Dines argues from a clear position and it's better to know that going in than to mistake it for neutrality. Porn's industry harms are documented, and the trafficking and coercion cases are a matter of public record. Her cultural claims are more contested than her industry ones, which is worth separating as you listen. The documented part is strong enough by itself.

column2: Ran Gavrieli's Testimony - Why I stopped watching porn
column5: Gavrieli's testimony works because it's an account of a decision rather than a lecture. Porn shaped how he saw people, and he noticed, which most of us never do. Repeated exposure shifts expectations of real partners in ways that are hard to see from inside. Watch how you look at strangers for a week. That's the measurement that actually means something.

column2: The Truth About P*rn (ft. Gail Dines)
column5: Strong position clearly stated, and there's value in the unambiguous version even where I'd temper it. Porn is built on other people's exploitation and marketed as private entertainment. Documented trafficking cases, including the GirlsDoPorn convictions, aren't contested. You can quit over the industry alone and never mention your brain. That reason holds up much better under scrutiny than shame does.

column2: Gail Dines, Ph.D. Interview - Truth About Porn
column5: Long-form interviews show the reasoning rather than just the conclusions, which makes them easier to assess. Porn's production harms are the part of this case that critics struggle to answer. Pornhub removed roughly ten million videos in December 2020 after payment processors withdrew over unverified content, which tells you something about what was hosted. That's a documented fact, not a talking point.

column2: Dr. Gail Dines Explores How Hypersexualized Media Legitimizes Prostitution
column5: The link she draws between media and the sex trade is contested, and it's fair to say so. Porn's documented harms, trafficking, coercion, unverified content, are strong enough without the broader cultural claims. Separate what's evidenced from what's argued as you watch. The evidenced part is genuinely damning. The argued part is worth considering and shouldn't be mistaken for settled.

column2: Why I stopped watching porn - Ran Gavrieli at TEDxJaffa 2013
column5: One of the most-watched talks in this space, and it holds up because it's a personal account rather than a statistical case. Porn changed what he wanted and how he saw people, and he found that unacceptable. Expectations of real partners shift with repeated exposure, which is well supported. You don't need a diagnosis to decide something is changing you. Noticing is sufficient grounds.

column2: Dr. Gail Dines - Nova Scotia Women's Summit
column5: Worth hearing in a forum aimed at the people most affected by the industry's output. Porn is produced under conditions that consumers almost never look at. The trafficking and coercion cases in the public record are not disputed by anyone serious. Look at the production side once, properly. It's harder to go back to casual consumption afterwards, which is rather the point.

column2: Dr. Gail Dines videos (playlist)
column5: A collected playlist saves you hunting, though watch it knowing it's advocacy rather than neutral survey. Porn's industry harms are the strongest part of this case and they're extensively documented. The cultural and causal claims are more contested and deserve more scepticism. Take the documented parts seriously and hold the rest loosely. That's how you end up with an argument that survives.

column2: Gail Dines Explains the Industry - PORN & How Toxic It Is To Our Culture
column5: Industry-focused rather than user-focused, which is a useful change of angle. Porn is a business whose incentives run directly against your interests, and that's structural rather than conspiratorial. Engagement-optimised products reliably produce compulsive use patterns, which is a design outcome rather than an accident. You're not weak for being caught. You were the target market of a very well-funded optimisation process.

column2: Porn Addiction is Finishing the Youth of South Africa
column5: Good to see this discussed openly in a South African context, because the conversation is badly needed and rarely had. Porn reaches young people everywhere the internet does, regardless of what anyone is prepared to discuss. Access to accurate, local-language information substantially increases whether people seek help. Talking about it publicly is itself the intervention. Keep having the conversation where it's still uncomfortable.

column2: SOUTH AFRICA PORN ADDICTION - PORN AT WORK AND CHURCH - SOCIAL MEDIA TRIGGERS - REHAB
column5: Covering workplace and church settings is unusual and useful, because those are where the secrecy is heaviest. Porn thrives in environments where admitting it would cost you your standing. Concealment predicts relapse more reliably than craving intensity across studies of compulsive behaviour. The higher the stakes of confession, the more the secrecy costs you. Find somewhere it's safe to be honest.

column2: Experts Tackle Increasing Revenge P*rn In Nigeria
column5: Revenge porn is a different harm from addiction and it deserves its own serious attention. Non-consensual image sharing destroys people's lives and is a crime in a growing number of jurisdictions, Nigeria included. Victims who report early and preserve evidence get better outcomes than those who stay silent out of shame. If this has happened to you, it was done to you. Report it.

column2: Porn Addiction is Not About Sex (How to Break Free) - Pastor Dolapo Lawal
column5: "Not about sex" is the most useful sentence in this whole subject, and he's right about it. Porn is a coping mechanism for stress, loneliness and boredom far more often than an expression of desire. Compulsive use commonly functions as emotional regulation rather than sexual behaviour. Find out what it's regulating for you. Once you know, you can replace the function instead of fighting the symptom.

column2: I Battled Porn Addiction - Pastor Isaac Oyedepo Opens Up
column5: A pastor being publicly honest about his own struggle does more than any sermon on the topic could. Porn relies on everyone assuming that respectable people don't have this problem. Disclosure by someone visible measurably reduces stigma and increases help-seeking in others. His honesty makes it safer for the next person to speak. That's not a small contribution.

column2: YOUNG PASTOR ADDICTED TO SEEING NAKED WOMEN
column5: Uncomfortable title, but the situation it describes is far more common than anyone admits publicly. Porn doesn't exempt clergy, and the shame is considerably heavier when your role depends on being above it. Higher stakes around disclosure predict more concealment, and concealment predicts worse outcomes. If your position makes honesty dangerous, find confidential help outside it. The isolation is the actual risk.

column2: Ghana to introduce mandatory ID checks for pornographic websites - Sam George
column5: Age verification is a real policy lever and worth watching how it plays out in practice. Porn reaches children at scale because access has essentially no barrier at all. Most people report first exposure between eleven and thirteen, usually accidental. Verification systems raise real privacy questions and they do reduce casual access. Whatever you think of the policy, the exposure problem it targets is genuine.

column2: كيف نتخلص من إدمان الإباحية - محمد بن شمس الدين
column5: كلام في محله، خصوصا أنه يعالج الموضوع دون تجريح للمشاهد. الإباحية منتج مصمم ليستهلك وقتك وتركيزك ولا يعطيك شيئا في المقابل. منظمة الصحة العالمية أدرجت اضطراب السلوك الجنسي القهري في التصنيف الدولي للأمراض عام ٢٠١٩، فالمسألة ليست وهما. ابدأ اليوم بخطوة صغيرة واحدة، فالتراكم هو ما ينجح فعلا لا الحماس المؤقت.

column2: كيف تتخلص من إدمان مشاهدة الإباحية - مصطفى حسني
column5: أسلوبه فيه رحمة أكثر من التوبيخ، وهذا بالضبط ما يحتاجه من يحاول التوقف. الإباحية تعيش على الصمت والخجل، وكلما زاد جلد الذات زاد الانتكاس. الأبحاث تظهر أن الشعور بالعار من أقوى مؤشرات استمرار السلوك القهري، أقوى من الرغبة نفسها. سامح نفسك بسرعة بعد الزلة، فالفجوة بين الزلة ولوم النفس هي التي تطيل المشكلة.

column2: الطريق إلى الحرية - كيف تتوقف عن مشاهدة الإباحية؟
column5: العنوان دقيق، لأن المسألة فعلا تحرر وليست مجرد امتناع. الإباحية تحول دافعا طبيعيا إلى عادة قهرية تكرهها وتكررها في الوقت نفسه. الدراسات السلوكية تؤكد أن تغيير البيئة أنجع بكثير من الاعتماد على الإرادة وحدها. غير مكان هاتفك في الليل قبل أن تختبر عزيمتك. العوائق الصغيرة تفعل ما لا تفعله الوعود الكبيرة.

column2: فاهم 52 - كيف تنقذ نفسك من إدمان الإباحية؟ مع د. محمد عبد الجواد
column5: جميل أن يتناول طبيب نفسي الموضوع بلغة علمية بعيدا عن الوعظ. الإباحية ليست مجرد ذنب، بل عادة لها آلية عصبية واضحة ومتكررة. الاستخدام القهري غالبا وسيلة لتنظيم القلق والوحدة أكثر منه رغبة جنسية. ابحث عن الشعور الذي يسبق الفتح، فهو الهدف الحقيقي للعلاج. حين تعالج السبب تضعف العادة من تلقاء نفسها.

column2: طريقة التخلص من إدمان مشاهدة المواقع والأفلام الإباحية - فتاوى الناس
column5: طرح عملي أكثر منه تنظيري، وهذا ما يحتاجه الناس فعلا. الإباحية متاحة خلال ثوان، أما عزيمتك فليست كذلك. أثبتت الأبحاث أن التخطيط المسبق لموقف محدد أقوى بكثير من النية العامة في التوقف. حدد الآن ماذا ستفعل في الساعة التي تضعف فيها عادة. الخطة التي تكتبها اليوم هي التي تنقذك ليلا.

column2: تخلص من إدمان الإباحية للأبد - محاضرة التعافي - بودكاست بهدوء مع كريم
column5: حلقة طويلة لكنها تستحق، لأن الاختصار يحذف الجزء الصعب من الموضوع. الإباحية بنيت عندك عبر سنوات من التكرار، ولن تنهار بقرار واحد. التعافي السلوكي يقاس بالأشهر لا بالأيام، وهذا ما تؤكده أبحاث المرونة العصبية. اصبر أطول مما يبدو معقولا. الفتور الذي تشعر به الآن هو بداية عودة الأمور إلى طبيعتها.

column2: أقوى 8 خطوات تخليك تبطل الإباحية نهائيا
column5: ثماني خطوات كثيرة، ويكفيك منها اثنتان تلتزم بهما فعلا. الإباحية تستغل أي ثغرة تتركها مفتوحة، ولذلك التغطية أهم من الكمال. الجمع بين تغيير البيئة والدعم الاجتماعي يتفوق على أي وسيلة منفردة في الأبحاث السلوكية. اختر خطوتين وطبقهما الليلة. خطوتان تنفذان خير من ثمان تعجبك ولا تبدأ بها أبدا.

column2: التعافي من الإباحية والعادة السرية بأسبوع واحد؟!
column5: أسبوع واحد وعد متفائل، ومن الأمانة قول ذلك قبل أن يبدأ أحد فيحبط. الإباحية شكلت استجابتك عبر سنوات، والأسبوع بداية لا نهاية. إعادة ضبط حساسية المكافأة تستغرق أسابيع إلى أشهر بحسب الأدبيات العلمية. اعتبر الأسبوع انطلاقة جيدة ثم واصل. البداية القوية مفيدة بشرط ألا تتوقف عند خط نهاية وهمي.

column2: Pharmastan - How to break free from porn addiction?
column5: طرح طبي هادئ، وهو ما ينقص أغلب المحتوى العربي في هذا الموضوع. الإباحية تستهلك في الخفاء، والخفاء نفسه هو ما يطيل عمر العادة. الكتمان مؤشر على الانتكاس أقوى من شدة الرغبة في الدراسات المتعلقة بالسلوك القهري. أخبر شخصا واحدا تثق به هذا الأسبوع. ستتفاجأ كم يصغر الأمر حين يقال بصوت مسموع.

column2: حصة علاج إدمان الإباحية التي لن تحتاج غيرها
column5: محتوى منظم أفضل من مقطع تحفيزي يزول أثره بعد ساعة. الإباحية تحضر يوميا، فلا بد أن يكون بديلك يوميا أيضا. الالتزام المنتظم ببرنامج أو مجموعة دعم من أقوى مؤشرات الاستمرار في التعافي. لا تنتظر الحماس. ابن روتينا يعمل في الأيام التي لا تشعر فيها بأي رغبة في المحاولة أصلا.

column2: পর্ন আসক্তি থেকে মুক্তি সম্ভব - মো সাদেক হোসেন মিনহাজ - Bangla Book Review
column5: রিভিউটা কাজের, কারণ এই বিষয়ে বাংলায় ভালো কিছু পাওয়া সত্যিই কঠিন। পর্ন এমন একটা অভ্যাস যা আপনার সময় আর মনোযোগ কেড়ে নিয়ে বিনিময়ে কিছুই দেয় না। বিশ্ব স্বাস্থ্য সংস্থা ২০১৯ সালে বাধ্যতামূলক যৌন আচরণ ব্যাধিকে স্বীকৃতি দিয়েছে, তাই এটা কল্পনা নয়। আজই ছোট একটা পদক্ষেপ নিন। ধারাবাহিকতাই কাজ করে, উৎসাহ নয়।

column2: পর্নোগ্রাফি থেকে মুক্তির সহজ উপায় - Zannatul Ferdous Psychologist
column5: একজন মনোবিজ্ঞানীর কাছ থেকে শোনা অনেক বেশি কাজে দেয়, শুধু ভয় দেখানোর চেয়ে। পর্ন একা থাকার কষ্ট সাময়িকভাবে ঢেকে দেয়, আর পরে সেই একাকীত্বকেই আরও বাড়িয়ে তোলে। গবেষণায় দেখা যায় একাকীত্ব আর একঘেয়েমি যৌন আকাঙ্ক্ষার চেয়ে অনেক বেশি বার এই অভ্যাসের কারণ হয়। আগে কী অনুভব করছিলেন সেটা খুঁজুন। সমাধান ওখানেই।

column2: ৭ দিনে পর্ন ও হস্তমৈথুনের আসক্তি থেকে মুক্তি - Dr. Asif Anowar
column5: সাত দিন একটু বেশি আশাবাদী, শুরুতেই এটা জানা ভালো যাতে হতাশ না হন। পর্ন বছরের পর বছর ধরে অভ্যাস গড়েছে, এক সপ্তাহে তা পুরোটা ভাঙে না। মস্তিষ্কের পুরস্কার ব্যবস্থা স্বাভাবিক হতে কয়েক সপ্তাহ থেকে কয়েক মাস সময় লাগে। সাত দিনকে শুরু ভাবুন, শেষ নয়। ভালো শুরুর দাম আছে, যদি আপনি না থামেন।

column2: পর্নোগ্রাফি আসক্তি থেকে বাঁচার সহজ উপায় - ডাঃ শাহনাজ চৌধুরী
column5: একজন চিকিৎসকের কাছ থেকে শোনা অনেক বেশি ভরসার, কারণ এখানে দোষারোপ নেই। পর্ন আপনার ঘুম, মনোযোগ আর আত্মসম্মান কেড়ে নেয়, বিনিময়ে কিছুই দেয় না। গবেষণায় দেখা যায় লজ্জা আর আত্মঘৃণা আসক্তি কমায় না, বরং বাড়িয়ে দেয়। নিজেকে দোষ দেওয়া বন্ধ করুন, আর একটা ছোট পরিবর্তন আজই শুরু করুন।

column2: পর্ণ আসক্তি থেকে মুক্তির উপায় - এনামুল হক চৌধুরী - AT-TAQWA MASJID
column5: খোলাখুলি এই বিষয়ে কথা বলাটাই সবচেয়ে বড় কাজ, কারণ চুপ থাকাই এই অভ্যাসের সবচেয়ে বড় শক্তি। পর্ন গোপনীয়তার উপর বেঁচে থাকে, আর একাকীত্বেই সবচেয়ে ভালো কাজ করে। গবেষণা বলে, লুকিয়ে রাখা আকাঙ্ক্ষার তীব্রতার চেয়েও বেশি করে পুনরাবৃত্তির কারণ হয়। বিশ্বস্ত একজনকে বলুন। বলার পরেই বোঝা অর্ধেক হালকা হয়ে যায়।

column2: পর্ন আসক্তি থেকে মুক্তির ১৪টি উপায় - Dr. Golam Mostofa Milon
column5: চৌদ্দটা উপায় অনেক বেশি, আপনার আসলে দুই-তিনটাই যথেষ্ট যদি সত্যিই মেনে চলেন। পর্ন আপনার রাখা যেকোনো ফাঁক দিয়েই ঢুকে পড়ে। আচরণ গবেষণা বলছে, পরিবেশ বদলানো একা ইচ্ছাশক্তির চেয়ে অনেক বেশি কার্যকর। দুটো উপায় বেছে নিন আর আজ রাতেই চালু করুন। দুটো করা চৌদ্দটা জানার চেয়ে ভালো।

column5: A coach's perspective is more useful than a marketing review, because they see what happens after month one. Porn doesn't disappear when the easy routes close, it just finds slower ones. column5: Fair question, and the "shameware" criticism deserves a serious answer rather than dismissal. Porn is harmful, and so is a monitoring setup that runs on humiliation and surveillance. Being watched and being supported are not the same thing.

column5: Parental control tools get lumped in with accountability software and they solve different problems. Porn exposure in young children is mostly accidental, and filters address exactly that case. Technical controls work best for the youngest users and lose effectiveness as kids get more capable. Use them early, expect them to be outgrown, and make sure the conversation outlasts the software.

column5: A structured course beats scattered videos, because sequence matters when you're rebuilding a habit. column5: Two things is a realistic number, and realistic is what people actually execute. Porn and mindless scrolling run on identical machinery, so treating them together makes sense. Compulsive behaviours cluster, and cutting one often leaves another expanding to fill the space. Deal with the whole pattern. Fixing only the most shameful symptom tends to leave you just as tired and just as distracted.

column5: Compilations like this do real work, because hearing several well-known men say it out loud breaks the isolation. column5: Putting the marriage and the addiction in the same conversation is the honest framing, because that's where the cost landed. column2: The Freedom Model Porn Addiction Analysis
column5: This argues against the addiction model entirely, and that position deserves engagement rather than dismissal. Porn is worth refusing regardless of which framework you use to describe it. The Freedom Model's choice-based approach is contested and DSM-5 did decline to list porn addiction, so they're not arguing from nothing. Take the parts that help you act. The framework was never the thing that changes behaviour.

column2: Freedom Coaching LLC (channel)
column5: Coaching businesses vary enormously and the field has no gatekeeping, so due diligence matters. Porn recovery attracts both serious practitioners and opportunists, with no easy way to tell them apart. Peer support groups and licensed therapists have considerably more evidence behind them than most coaching programmes. Ask about credentials and outcomes. A coach who dodges those questions has answered them.

column2: DEEP CLEAN Your Life Free Of Porn w/ Sathiya Sam - The Super Human Life Ep. 74
column5: Practical and structured, which is the useful end of the coaching world. Porn occupies the parts of your life you've left undefined, so cleaning those up genuinely helps. Comprehensive lifestyle change consistently outperforms targeting a single behaviour in isolation. Work on sleep, exercise and social contact alongside the habit. People are always surprised how much of this was downstream of exhaustion.

column2: Sathiya Sam - How To Quit P*rn For Good
column5: "For good" is a large promise, though the underlying method here is reasonable enough. Porn doesn't give a permanent guarantee to anyone, and programmes that promise one are overselling. Relapse is common even after long abstinence, and planning for it predicts better long-term outcomes than assuming permanence. Aim for durable rather than permanent. Durable includes a plan for the bad month.

column2: The Last Relapse - Sathiya Sam
column5: The "last relapse" framing is memorable, though it risks the all-or-nothing trap. Porn benefits enormously from you treating one slip as the end of the attempt. Rigid framing is associated with more severe binges after a lapse, which is well documented across addictions. Aim for a last relapse, absolutely. Just have a plan for the one after it, in case.

column2: Sathiya Sam Interview
column5: Interviews show the reasoning behind a method, which helps you judge whether it fits you. Porn recovery advice is highly individual and no single approach works for everyone. Matching an approach to the person's actual drivers produces better outcomes than applying one method universally. Listen for whether his framing describes your situation. If it doesn't, keep looking rather than blaming yourself.

column2: Sathiya Sam (channel)
column5: Consistent content from one coach is worth more than scattered clips from twenty, because approaches conflict. Porn recovery advice online is contradictory enough to paralyse people. Consistency of approach is associated with better adherence, regardless of which reasonable method you choose. Pick one credible source and follow it properly for three months. Switching methods every fortnight is its own kind of avoidance.

column2: Special interview with Life Coach and Author Sathiya Sam
column5: Long-form interviews are where you find out whether someone actually knows the subject. Porn recovery has enough confident amateurs in it already. Practitioners with lived experience and formal training tend to outperform those with only one of the two. Listen critically, take what's useful, and check anything that sounds too certain. Certainty is the main warning sign in this field.

column2: How Porn Is Quietly Destroying Millions of Men - Sathiya Sam
column5: "Quietly" is the right word, because the damage accumulates without any single dramatic moment. Porn takes hours and attention in amounts too small to notice until the years add up. Compulsive use is commonly invisible to everyone around the person, including those closest to them. Add up your actual weekly hours honestly, once. That number tends to be more persuasive than any argument.

column2: How to Address Porn Addiction and Find the Path to Recovery with Sathiya Sam
column5: Pairing the problem with the path out is what makes content like this usable rather than just alarming. Porn keeps people stuck partly because the next step is never specified. Concrete, specific next steps increase follow-through substantially compared with general advice to seek help. Pick the single smallest step named here and do it today. The specificity is what makes it happen.

column2: The Last Relapse with Sathiya Sam
column5: Worth hearing him develop the idea at length rather than as a slogan. Porn survives on the belief that this time is different, which is exactly the thought that precedes every relapse. Recognising your own pre-relapse thinking is one of the more effective tools in relapse prevention. Learn your specific version of that thought. Once you can hear it coming, it loses most of its authority.

column2: Sathiya Sam - Recovered Porn Consumer & Recovery Coach - Consider Before Consuming Podcast
column5: Someone who's been through it and works in it professionally is a better bet than either alone. Porn recovery is full of people with one qualification or the other. Lived experience plus formal training tends to produce better engagement than either by itself. Ask any coach about both. If they only have the story, get a therapist alongside them.

column2: The Biggest Unmet Need - The Mindful Habit
column5: The unmet need framing is the most useful idea in this whole corner of the internet. Porn is meeting something real, badly, and removing it without addressing the need leaves a hole. Compulsive use commonly functions as emotional regulation rather than as a sexual behaviour. Work out what the need actually is. Then meet it properly, because it doesn't go away because you disapprove of it.

column2: Craig Perra, The Mindful Habit (channel)
column5: Perra is direct and occasionally abrasive, which suits some people and repels others. Porn recovery advice needs to fit the person, not the other way round. Therapeutic alliance, whether you actually trust the person, predicts outcomes better than the specific method used. If his style works for you, use it. If it doesn't, that's information rather than failure on your part.

column2: Craig Perra Interview (Porn Addiction)
column5: Interview format lets him explain the reasoning rather than just issue instructions. Porn is maintained by avoiding your own internal state, and his approach targets exactly that. Mindfulness-based interventions have reasonable evidence for reducing craving reactivity in compulsive behaviour. Learn to notice without acting. It's a dull, teachable skill and it generalises far beyond this particular problem.

column2: Understanding CSATs - Choosing the Right Sex Addiction Therapist
column5: Explaining what a CSAT is and how to choose one is genuinely practical and rarely covered. Porn keeps people out of treatment partly because nobody knows what treatment looks like. Specialist training matters: therapists with specific sexual-compulsivity credentials tend to produce better outcomes than generalists in this area. If you're going to pay for help, pay for the right kind. Ask about the credential specifically.

column2: Mindfulness Basic Training for Sex & Porn Addicts - The Mindful Habit
column5: Calling it basic training is accurate, because this is a skill you practise rather than a thing you understand. Porn is a response to discomfort, and tolerating discomfort is trainable. Mindfulness practice is associated with reduced craving reactivity and improved impulse control across several studies. Start with five minutes daily. Boring, small, and repeated beats ambitious and abandoned every single time.

column2: The Mindful Habit (channel)
column5: Consistent content from one source helps, because contradictory advice is its own obstacle. Porn recovery online is a mess of conflicting frameworks and confident strangers. Sticking with one reasonable approach is associated with better adherence than sampling many. Choose a lane and stay in it for a few months. You can always change later, once you have actual evidence.

column2: Finding Balance - Overcoming Sex and Porn Addiction with the REST Approach
column5: Acronym frameworks are memorable, and memorability matters when you need something at 1am. Porn moves fast and complicated plans collapse under pressure. Simple, well-rehearsed coping strategies outperform elaborate ones under stress, because stress degrades complex thinking. Learn one short framework properly. Something you can recall instantly beats something clever you'll never retrieve in the moment.

column2: The Mindful Habit with Craig Perra
column5: Worth hearing the whole approach rather than pieces of it, since these methods are designed as systems. Porn exploits partial implementation, which is how most people apply advice. Programme fidelity, actually doing the whole thing, predicts outcomes considerably better than partial adoption. Either do a method properly or pick a smaller one. Half of a good system usually performs worse than all of a simple one.

column2: The Shocking Link Between Posture and Mood - Sex & Porn Addiction Edition
column5: The posture angle sounds like a stretch and there's a modest real effect underneath it. Porn thrives when your mood and energy are already low. Posture-mood links exist in the research though the effects are small and the replications mixed. Don't build your recovery on it. Do fix sleep, movement and daylight, which have far stronger evidence and work on the same problem.

column2: Set Goals or Fail in Your Fight Against Sex Addiction and Porn Addiction
column5: Goal-setting gets dismissed as obvious and then skipped by almost everyone. Porn fills whatever space you haven't deliberately assigned to something else. Specific, written goals outperform vague intentions consistently across behaviour-change research. Write down what you want your evenings to actually look like. The plan for what you're doing instead matters more than the plan for what you're stopping.

column2: Mark Queppet (channel)
column5: Queppet takes a broader view than most, treating this as one part of building a life rather than a standalone fight. Porn expands into whatever a life leaves empty. Approach-motivated change, moving toward something you want, is more durable than avoidance-motivated change. Build something you'd be reluctant to interrupt. That's a far better defence than any amount of resolve.

column2: The End Of Universal Man? Mark Queppet Speaks (MQS) #0001
column5: Candid content about a creator's own difficulties is more useful than another polished lesson. Porn recovery content often hides how non-linear the people making it actually are. Honesty about setbacks from someone visible reduces shame in the audience measurably. Whatever your own setbacks look like, they're more normal than the highlight reels suggest. Keep going anyway.

column2: The Universal Man Podcast w/ Dr. Trish Leigh & Mark Queppet, CPC
column5: Two practitioners disagreeing productively is more informative than either one lecturing. Porn recovery has genuine methodological disputes and pretending otherwise misleads people. The field has real disagreement about mechanisms and terminology, which is normal for a young research area. Listen to where they differ. That's usually where the honest uncertainty lives, and it's worth knowing.

column2: How to QUIT Pornography feat. Mark Queppet - Ep. 31
column5: Practical rather than theoretical, which is what most people clicking this actually want. Porn survives on plans that stay general and never reach a specific action. Implementation intentions, deciding exactly what you'll do in a specific situation, reliably outperform general goals. Take one concrete thing from this and set it up before you close the tab. Right now, not later.
